details: The Swiss National Bank (SNB) President Martin Schlegel indicated the central bank's readiness to intervene in foreign exchange markets, citing the impact of the Iran war on the Swiss franc. Geopolitical risks could drive safe-haven flows into crypto, but central bank intervention adds uncertainty, and current market predictions for Bitcoin remain stable.
title: Swiss National Bank Signals Forex Intervention Amid Geopolitical Tensions

details: The US administration has frozen $344 million in cryptocurrency reportedly linked to Iran to intensify economic pressure. Increased government action against illicit use and freezing substantial funds can raise regulatory concerns and potentially deter institutional adoption.
title: US Freezes $344 Million in Crypto Linked to Iran

details: The People's Bank of China has introduced new regulations explicitly prohibiting online marketing services for cryptocurrency issuance and trading. This framework aims to standardize financial product marketing while restricting accessibility and growth for the crypto market in a major economy.
title: China Prohibits Online Marketing for Crypto Issuance and Trading
